name: 1st Choice Auto Repair
hook: Your customers on Stone Street get a ride to work, a couch with the pugs and a straight price from Roger and Beth — the ones still looking for an inspection shop in Augusta could see that and book it from their phone. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you and Beth run 1st Choice Auto Repair on the corner of Stone Street and Route 17, you do Maine state inspections, computer diagnostics, brakes, exhaust, steering and suspension and engine swaps, you offer a night drop and a ride home after drop-off, and dogs are always welcome in the office
na_stronie: your names, phone, e-mail and the Stone Street address up front, your services in your own words (computer diagnostics, state inspections, complete safety analysis, drivability problems, tune-ups, oil changes, brake repair, mufflers and exhaust systems), Monday–Friday 7:30–4:30 with the night drop and the ride-home line, online booking and a contact form that lands in your inbox, your sign, your engine-bay photo and — of course — the pugs in the window
dlaczego: A Maine driver whose sticker is due searches for an inspection shop on a phone and books the first one that shows its hours and a button. A page of your own that does that, with Roger and Beth on it, wins that search.
